quote_lines_discount_pair.name: quote_lines_discount_pair
quote_lines_discount_pair.value: ("quote_lines"."discount_kind" is null and "quote_lines"."discount_value" is null) or ("quote_lines"."discount_kind" in ('percent', 'amount') and "quote_lines"."discount_value" >= 0)

quote_lines_tax_pair.name: quote_lines_tax_pair
quote_lines_tax_pair.value: ("quote_lines"."tax_rate_name" is null and "quote_lines"."tax_rate_bps" is null) or ("quote_lines"."tax_rate_name" is not null and "quote_lines"."tax_rate_bps" between 0 and 10000)

quotes_sent_complete.name: quotes_sent_complete
quotes_sent_complete.value: "quotes"."status" in ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED') or ("quotes"."customer_id" is not null and "quotes"."number" is not null)

invoice_lines_discount_pair.name: invoice_lines_discount_pair
invoice_lines_discount_pair.value: ("invoice_lines"."discount_kind" is null and "invoice_lines"."discount_value" is null) or ("invoice_lines"."discount_kind" in ('percent', 'amount') and "invoice_lines"."discount_value" >= 0)

invoice_lines_tax_pair.name: invoice_lines_tax_pair
invoice_lines_tax_pair.value: ("invoice_lines"."tax_rate_name" is null and "invoice_lines"."tax_rate_bps" is null) or ("invoice_lines"."tax_rate_name" is not null and "invoice_lines"."tax_rate_bps" between 0 and 10000)

invoices_issued_complete.name: invoices_issued_complete
invoices_issued_complete.value: "invoices"."status" = 'DRAFT' or ("invoices"."customer_id" is not null and "invoices"."number" is not null)

payments_void_reason.name: payments_void_reason
payments_void_reason.value: "payments"."voided_at" is null or "payments"."void_reason" is not null
